darkest_chain.reason: One descent per DD2 act boss (Denial, Resentment, Obsession, Ambition, Cowardice). DD1's chain has four quests but only two boss fights; its second and third quests are curio objectives (beacons, teleporter) with no DD2 counterpart, while each DD2 confession is a separate arena and mechanic. Five kill-boss quests also give DD1's 'never again' rule 20 heroes to rotate instead of 16.

quests.name: The Burned Gallery
quests.goal_text: Explore the upper Ruins and come back alive.
quests.intro_narration: You will remember the house as it was. Forget it. The mob that came for me with torches never went home, and what they could not burn they now guard. Walk my galleries, count what is left, and learn how little the name still buys you.
quests.victory_narration: A few rooms taken back, a few torches put out. It is a small sum against the debt, but you have made the first payment. There will be others.

quests.name: The Keeper of the Catalogue
quests.goal_text: Find the Librarian in the Ruins and put out his fire.
quests.intro_narration: I hired a keeper for the books I dared not read alone. He read them all. When the mob broke the doors he did not flee; he took their torches and taught them what deserves burning. He is cataloguing still, and you are not on his shelves.
quests.victory_narration: Ash where the reading desk stood. He will be back at his index before the embers cool. A catalogue is never finished, only interrupted.

quests.name: The Mother's Clearing
quests.goal_text: Cut down the Mother of Threads in the Weald.
quests.intro_narration: When my own arts faltered I went into the wood, to the women who know how flesh is knit. Their mother asked a price in tenants, and I paid from the rolls without reading the names. She still sits at her loom. The thread is not wool.
quests.victory_narration: The loom is cut and the clearing stinks of scorched silk. Her daughters carried off the spindle. They are a thrifty family; nothing is wasted.

quests.name: The Pit-Master
quests.goal_text: Kill Meat Hook, master of the pens under the Warrens.
quests.intro_narration: The things I made under the aqueduct needed keepers, so I sent my huntsmen down with hooks and chains. Men who herd beasts in the dark soon stop noticing the difference. The largest of them hangs his kills on a post. He was my kennel-master once.
quests.victory_narration: The post is bare and its keeper is so much meat. The herd will run loose in the tunnels without him. I am not certain you have improved matters.

quests.name: Tribute
quests.goal_text: Kill the Leviathan beneath the Cove.
quests.intro_narration: My cargoes came by sea, and the sea asked a toll. I paid in lanterns, then in livestock, then in the fisherfolk's daughters, one each quarter-day, rowed out past the shoal. Something large grew fond of the arrangement. It still comes in on the tide to collect.
quests.victory_narration: The water is red to the harbour mouth. It sank rather than died; the deep keeps its own ledgers. The quarter-day will come round again.

quests.name: A Sermon Below
quests.goal_text: Silence the Exemplar in the crypt beneath the Ruins.
quests.intro_narration: The diggers I sent deepest came back singing. One among them stood taller than the rest and spoke of a hunger waiting patiently below the cellar. I had him flogged. He thanked me. His congregation meets in the family crypt now, among your grandfathers.
quests.victory_narration: The pulpit is broken and the choir dispersed. But a title like his is not buried with the man. Someone is already learning the hymn.

quests.name: The Unpaid Company
quests.goal_text: Find the Dreaming General in his keep and end his command.
quests.intro_narration: I hired a battalion to keep my roads and the hamlet's mouth shut. When the coin ran thin I marched them into the Weald after a rumour and had the bridge cut behind them. They never deserted. Their General sleeps under a root, and still gives orders.
quests.victory_narration: The root is severed and the old soldier is quiet. His men stand to their posts regardless. No one has told them the war is over; no one ever told them what it was.

quests.name: The Lowest Larder
quests.goal_text: Destroy the Harvest Child and the meat it feeds on.
quests.intro_narration: The failures had to go somewhere, and it was a hungry year. I had the carcasses dressed and sold cheap to the gentry of the hamlet. They acquired the taste. Their table is still laid in the lowest larder, and something small sits at the head of it.
quests.victory_narration: The table is overturned. Those who dined there will find other meat; that sort always does. The child was the only one who never asked for more.

quests.name: The Grounded Barge
quests.goal_text: End the Archduke's revel in the wreck at the Cove.
quests.intro_narration: At my last revels I poured a vintage I should have left corked. The guests thirsted ever after. When the mob came they fled by barge, and the barge came back on the next tide, holed and listing. The Archduke holds court in the wreck. He is still my guest.
quests.victory_narration: The host is toppled and the music stops. His court will slink off to dry their finery. They remember the taste, and they know whose cellar it came from.

quests.name: The Revised Index
quests.goal_text: Find the Librarian in the Ruins and put out his fire.
quests.intro_narration: You burned him once and he took notes. The stacks rise again in the long gallery, taller, and the zealots queue to be read to. He has added a volume since your last visit. I am told it concerns you.
quests.victory_narration: The stacks are down and the pages scattered. Knowledge is patient, and so is he. Keep the windows shut; the smell of smoke travels.

quests.name: Respun
quests.goal_text: Cut down the Mother of Threads in the Weald.
quests.intro_narration: A cut thread can be knotted. The daughters have sat their mother back at the loom and fed her what the Weald could spare. The fungus fruits wherever her shadow has lain. You will know the path by what hangs above it.
quests.victory_narration: Twice unpicked. The coven keeps to the hollows now and the paths are nearly clean. Burn what you wore into that clearing.

quests.name: Fresh Hooks
quests.goal_text: Kill Meat Hook, master of the pens under the Warrens.
quests.intro_narration: The tribe has dragged him back to the post and hung him there to mend, as they would hang a carcass to cure. It has worked. He is leaner, and angrier, and the swine no longer need driving. They follow him.
quests.victory_narration: Down again, and the tunnels ring with squealing. The beast-men are scattering upward, toward the light. Bar the cellar doors.

quests.name: The Tide Returns
quests.goal_text: Kill the Leviathan beneath the Cove.
quests.intro_narration: The fog has not lifted since you wounded it. It has come back up the channel with a longer reach and the patience of the drowned. The dockers leave the old tribute on the stones out of habit. Do not stand where they leave it.
quests.victory_narration: Driven under once more, and the shroud thins a little. You can see the shoal now. You can see what is piled on it.

quests.name: The Second Exemplar
quests.goal_text: Silence the Exemplar in the crypt beneath the Ruins.
quests.intro_narration: They have raised another. The same robe, the same lifted palm, a different face beneath the hood, or perhaps the same one, stretched to fit. The altar in the crypt is fed again. Faith is the only crop this estate has never failed to yield.
quests.victory_narration: Twice now you have answered the sermon with steel. The faithful are fewer and quieter. They are also deeper, where the walls are warm.

quests.name: Reveille
quests.goal_text: Find the Dreaming General in his keep and end his command.
quests.intro_narration: The drums are sounding in the Weald again. The root has found him, as roots do, and through it he dreams of muster rolls and arrears. Every man I owed is on parade. They have had a long time to count what is due.
quests.victory_narration: The parade is dismissed. Bark closes over the wound even as you leave. Soldiers, like debts, have a way of coming back.

quests.name: Second Helping
quests.goal_text: Destroy the Harvest Child and the meat it feeds on.
quests.intro_narration: The feast has been laid afresh. The meat I threw away has learned to pile itself on the platter, and the diners no longer trouble with knives. The child presides. It has grown no older. It has only grown.
quests.victory_narration: Scraped off the boards a second time. The smell will stay in the stone for a generation. Eat nothing that comes from below.

quests.name: A Second Invitation
quests.goal_text: End the Archduke's revel in the wreck at the Cove.
quests.intro_narration: The barge is lit again. He has summoned what remains of the county's good names to a banquet, and the dockside has been emptied to supply the table. You were not invited. I suggest you take offence.
quests.victory_narration: The banquet is spoiled and the guests are wet and wretched. He bowed as he fell. Breeding outlasts nearly everything.

quests.name: The Last Reader
quests.goal_text: Find the Librarian in the Ruins and put out his fire.
quests.intro_narration: Every book I owned has passed through his hands and into the fire, save one. He keeps it closed on his knee and will not burn it until he understands it. Do not let him finish the page. I did, and you have seen what followed.
quests.victory_narration: The library is silent, properly silent, for the first time since I learned my letters. Whatever he read last, he took with him. Be glad of it.

quests.name: The Whole Cloth
quests.goal_text: Cut down the Mother of Threads in the Weald.
quests.intro_narration: She has woven the wood itself into her work: root, web and sinew in a single weave, and the hamlet's missing stitched along the hem. There is a place left open in the pattern. She measured you for it the first time you came.
quests.victory_narration: It is finished. The threads hang slack and the trees are only trees. I never did learn the names I gave her. You might read them, if you can bear it.

quests.name: The Last of the Herd
quests.goal_text: Kill Meat Hook, master of the pens under the Warrens.
quests.intro_narration: What stands at the post now was never taught to kneel. It remembers the hooks, the chains, and the man who ordered them forged. It cannot reach me. It has learned your scent instead, and it is patient in the way that hungry things are patient.
quests.victory_narration: The pens are silent. I built them to hold my failures and they held, after a fashion, longer than I did. Seal the aqueduct.

quests.name: What the Sea Was Owed
quests.goal_text: Kill the Leviathan beneath the Cove.
quests.intro_narration: It has stopped waiting for the tide. It lies across the harbour floor with a hand in every cellar on the waterfront, and it calls the debt by my name. I never meant to settle it. You must, and in the only coin it will not take.
quests.victory_narration: The Cove is only a cove. Cold water, grey stones, gulls. I had forgotten it could be so. The account is closed.

quests.name: The Word Made Flesh
quests.goal_text: Silence the Exemplar in the crypt beneath the Ruins.
quests.intro_narration: The third to wear the name does not preach. He has seen the thing he praised and come back up to tell of it, and the telling has remade him. Every word he speaks is true. That is precisely why he cannot be allowed to finish.
quests.victory_narration: The crypt belongs to the dead again, who make better neighbours. What he saw is still down there. You are nearer to it than you would like.

quests.name: The Long Watch Ends
quests.goal_text: Find the Dreaming General in his keep and end his command.
quests.intro_narration: He is more tree than man now, and the whole wood leans the way he dreams. The battalion will hold until relieved; that was the order, and I signed it. Go and relieve them. Take an axe. Take my apology, for whatever weight it carries.
quests.victory_narration: The keep is empty and the standard is down. It was the only contract I ever made that the other party kept to the letter. Let them rest.

quests.name: The Final Course
quests.goal_text: Destroy the Harvest Child and the meat it feeds on.
quests.intro_narration: Everything I discarded has gathered at that table: every botched shape, every cut that would not close, heaped and seasoned and calling itself a harvest. It was my hunger first. Go down and clear the plates.
quests.victory_narration: The larder is empty and the lords of the table have nothing left to chew but each other. Of all my leavings, this was the hardest to look at. You looked.

quests.name: Last of the Vintage
quests.goal_text: End the Archduke's revel in the wreck at the Cove.
quests.intro_narration: He has drunk the Cove dry and now looks inland, toward the hamlet and the house where the first bottle was opened. He means to come home. He means to thank me. Meet him at the waterline and decline on my behalf.
quests.victory_narration: The court is ended and every title is extinct. I laid that table to be admired, and I was. Pour what is left of the cellar into the sea.

quests.name: What I Would Not See
quests.goal_text: Break the Shackles of Denial.
quests.intro_narration: You have come to the door beneath all my doors. I told myself it was a discovery. I told myself the screams were wind in the shafts. Four locks hold the first chamber shut, and I fastened every one myself, so that I need not know what I knew.
quests.victory_narration: The locks are broken and I can no longer pretend. Thank you. It is the cruellest kindness anyone has done me.

quests.name: The Breath I Held
quests.goal_text: Still the Seething Sigh.
quests.intro_narration: They mocked my dig in the taverns: the idle lord and his hole in the ground. I swallowed every laugh and kept it warm. It is here, still breathing, grown vast on years of slights I never forgave. Mind the heat. It was meant for them.
quests.victory_narration: The last breath is let out. They were right to laugh, and I hated them for being right. It is quieter without it.

quests.name: The Unblinking Study
quests.goal_text: Put out the Focused Fault.
quests.intro_narration: I could not look away. Not from the dig, not from the diagrams, not when the house emptied and the lamps guttered. All that watching has gathered in one chamber, and it watches still. It will fix on one of you. It will not be distracted. I never was.
quests.victory_narration: Every eye is shut. I spent my life staring down a shaft and never once looked up at who was standing beside me.

quests.name: The Grasping Hand
quests.goal_text: Sever the Ravenous Reach.
quests.intro_narration: I wanted more than a name. I wanted to be owed by creation itself. That wanting has hands now, and they are never full. It took the family silver, the hamlet, the estate. It reaches for you because you are the last thing I have not yet spent.
quests.victory_narration: The hand lies open and empty, as it always was. Everything it ever closed upon turned to debt. You are not for the taking.

quests.name: The Body of Work
quests.goal_text: Face the Body of Work and finish it.
quests.intro_narration: At the last I saw what I had made, and I fled. I put a pistol to the question and left the answer to you. Here it stands, all my labours in a single frame. It will show you your own failures. Do what I could not, and stay.
quests.victory_narration: It is done. You did not run. The house is ruined, the name is ruined, and you stood where I could not. Go up into the light. There is nothing left down here that is yours.
